def trace(g, start, d0, hand='left'):
    # dirs: 0 up,1 right,2 down,3 left ; left-hand: prefer turning left
    H,W=g.shape

    pos=start

        order = [(d-1)%4, d, (d+1)%4, (d+2)%4] if hand=='left' else [(d+1)%4, d, (d-1)%4, (d+2)%4]

            if 0<=np_[0]<H and 0<=np_[1]<W and free[np_]:
                pos=np_; d=nd; moved=True; break
        if not moved: break
        if pos==start and step>2: break
    return visited
